messages:
sahil: Spinning up a follow-up thread from the postmortem. Goal: capture remediation owners, short timelines, and a recurring-pattern tracker for vendor/cloud/auth/model-registry outages. Keep replies short (ack + ETA).

anya: Ack. I'll take the recurring-pattern doc and own the RCA taxonomy. ETA: initial doc by Fri.

chris: I'll own cert/key rotation resilience for external auth providers (grace window + fallback JWKS). PoC: next Wed.

vivian: I'll run model-registry hardening: rate-limit backpressure + local metadata cache. Patch for cache by Tue, design for geo-replication after.

roland: I'll handle cloud provider quota mitigation: pre-warmed spare capacity and capacity-guard rails for autoscale. Proposal by Mon.

legal-bot: Noted: Request for emergency SLA clause and refundable credits flagged to procurement. Legal will draft template by next Thu.

sahil: Two quick rules: 1) prefer short-term pragmatic fixes (circuit-breakers, cached tokens) to buy time for durable changes. 2) owners must post a blocker slashed ETA if anything slips.

anya: Pattern doc will track: auth flaps, registry throttling, provider network blips, and AE response times. Will include recurrence heatmap.

chris: Technical note: we should add a client-side JWKS cache with jittered refresh and a KMS-signed emergency token path. Will show sketch in PoC.

vivian: For registry caching: we'll keep a 30s in-memory TTL and a stale-while-revalidate path. Also adding a read-retry with exponential backoff.

roland: Cloud quotas: I'll add automated quota-checking alerts that open a ticket and scale-down noncritical batch jobs when headroom <15%.

sahil: Good. Create measurable success criteria: reduce outage surface area (auth/reg reads) by 80% in short term; decrease incident MTTR for vendor-dep upsets to <15m for detection/triage.

devops-bot: Created tickets:
```
INF-4010 vendor-patterns-doc (assignee: anya)
INF-4011 auth-rotation-resilience (assignee: chris)
INF-4012 registry-cache-swr (assignee: vivian)
INF-4013 cloud-quota-guards (assignee: roland)
```
Links: https://jira.redwoodinfra/INF-4011

anya: I'll include a recurring incident checklist: immediate mitigation, short-term patch, long-term remediation, vendor escalation steps, and retrospective owner.

chris: Security note: emergency token path must be audited and reversible. We'll store issuance logs in immutable audit stream.

vivian: Ops ask: add a metric registry_read_stale_rate and an alert at 1% sustained for 5m. Will add to INF-4012.

roland: Also proposing a monthly "vendor chaos" run to test AE responsiveness and our fallback behavior. Will add calendar invite after we agree.

sahil: Let's do the chaos run only after short-term patches are in staging. Target window: 3 weeks out. Add drill pass/fail criteria.

legal-bot: Draft SLA amendment template will include AE response times, priority routing, and credit terms for repeated failures. Procurement will schedule vendor review.

anya: I'll track outcomes in the doc and add a section for recurring actors (which vendor subsystems are most often implicated).

chris: Starting PoC work for INF-4011. Will post a small diff and unit tests by Wed evening.

vivian: Patch for INF-4012 will be small; aim to roll to staging Thu and monitor.

roland: I'll prototype quota-guard logic in a feature-flagged service. ETA for staging flag: Mon.

sahil: Action owners recap: anya (INF-4010), chris (INF-4011), vivian (INF-4012), roland (INF-4013). Update Jira weekly and call out vendor/legal blockers here.

devops-bot: Recurring calendar entry added: "vendor-dep pattern review" first Monday of month. Ticket INF-4014.

anya: Ack. I'll publish the first pattern doc Friday and include the heatmap + initial mitigations table.

sahil: Thanks all. Will send a 2-line exec summary after Friday's doc. Reopen thread with any immediate vendor escalations.
